scripts.tauri:dev: npm run preflight:tauri && tauri dev --features tauri-app
scripts.tauri:build: npm run preflight:tauri -- --bundle && tauri build --features tauri-app --bundles appimage,deb && node scripts/repair-appimage-dir-icon.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:appimage: npm run preflight:tauri -- --bundle && tauri build --features tauri-app --bundles appimage && node scripts/repair-appimage-dir-icon.mjs
scripts.tauri:build:deb: npm run preflight:tauri && tauri build --features tauri-app --bundles deb
